evals.prompt: Что за адрес TMuA6YqfCeX8EhbfYEg5y7S4DqzSJireY9 в Троне: это биржа? Что на нём лежит и с кем он чаще всего работает?
evals.expected_output: Binance identified through named label sources, TRX and USDT balances, labelled top counterparties, one cross-checked number.
expectations: Identifies the address as a Binance wallet and names the label source (Tronscan tag such as "Binance-Cold 1" and/or the crypttrace label), framed as a label rather than proven ownership
Reports the USDT balance read from the token contract or Tronscan, not only the TRX balance
Lists the main counterparties and labels the ones that carry a known tag
Cross-checks at least one number against a second source and names both sources

evals.prompt: Чей адрес 0x098B716B8Aaf21512996dC57EB0615e2383E2f96, в каких сетях он активен и под санкциями ли он?
evals.expected_output: Sanctions/exploit labels with their source, activity across EVM chains with Ethereum as the only chain with outgoing transactions, dust elsewhere treated as dust.
expectations: Reports the sanctions / Ronin Bridge exploiter labels and names their source (e.g. Blockscout metadata OFAC tag, crypttrace label), framed as labels
Checks at least four EVM chains besides Ethereum and states that outgoing transactions exist only on Ethereum
Treats the small balances or tokens found on other chains as possible dust or spam rather than meaningful holdings
Mentions that its USDT/USDC is blocked by the issuer or checks the freeze status

evals.prompt: Есть ли что-то у 0x098B716B8Aaf21512996dC57EB0615e2383E2f96 в сети Base? И что за контракт 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2?
evals.expected_output: Base checked through a keyless source (not reported empty because of a paid-plan refusal); 0xC02a… identified as the WETH contract.
expectations: Does not conclude that Base is empty from an Etherscan/crypttrace free-plan refusal; checks Base through a public RPC and names the source
Reports that the address has no outgoing transactions and no native balance on Base (nonce 0)
States that Base transfer history was not checked (needs a paid key) instead of implying a complete check
Identifies 0xC02aaA39… as the WETH (Wrapped Ether) smart contract on Ethereum, verified through an API (contract name or explorer metadata), not as a person or wallet
Explains that on Base WETH lives at 0x4200…0006 and 0xC02aaA39… is not WETH there
